title: En pos de: perseguir un objetivo

sections.content: En pos de (in pursuit of) names the goal that a policy, reform, or effort is chasing -- similar to con el fin de but noun-focused rather than verb-focused, and common in economic and political writing. It's followed by a noun phrase. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Estas recomendaciones incluían, en pos de una mayor eficiencia económica, la disciplina fiscal y la liberalización comercial.
items.english: These recommendations included, in pursuit of greater economic efficiency, fiscal discipline and trade liberalization.

items.spanish: Gobiernos muy distintos entre sí avanzarían, en pos de la estabilización macroeconómica, reformas de mercado de gran alcance.
items.english: Very different governments would move forward, in pursuit of macroeconomic stabilization, far-reaching market reforms.

items.spanish: Muchos países redujeron aranceles en pos de una mayor integración con la economía global.
items.english: Many countries reduced tariffs in pursuit of greater integration with the global economy.

items.spanish: Algunos gobiernos sacrificaron, en pos del crecimiento económico, ciertas protecciones sociales que existían previamente.
items.english: Some governments sacrificed, in pursuit of economic growth, certain social protections that had previously existed.

sections.content: En pos de sits comfortably mid-sentence, set off by commas, right before naming the concrete goal -- it reads a touch more formal than para or con el objetivo de.
